headline: Meta spent $8,082 over 14 days with zero conversions, so I paused it. Direct's 2.4x rise lines up with AI-assistant mentions, not paid spend.

moves.reason: 14 days (Oct 18-31) $8,082 spend, 0 conversions, daily spend rising ~$525 to ~$644. Self-reported Instagram/Facebook share also fell to 0% in the last two weeks (was ~20%), so this looks like real delivery/creative/pixel failure, not only tracking. Pause is cheap to reverse; re-enable after checking pixel/creative.

Last 7d CPA $148.54, ROAS 0.96 (prior 4wk $168.92, 1.13). Every attribution model gives implied CPA of $76-135, so the result doesn't depend on the model: LinkedIn is below break-even. Cut 30% (300 to 210) rather than pause because it only gets 4.8-8.5% of credit and self-reported LinkedIn is 3-9%.

tests.hypothesis: Google Search gets 33% (first-touch) to 66% (last-touch) of credit. Part of that is last-click capture of buyers that email, Meta, or AI assistants persuaded first. A holdout will show how many conversions are truly incremental.
tests.design: Geo split: pause Google Search (brand terms first, then non-brand) in about 20% of matched regions for 3-4 weeks. Keep the rest unchanged. Measure total conversions and revenue from all channels, direct included, in held-out and control regions. Compare against pre-period trends. Start after Meta is resolved so the two changes don't overlap.

flag_verdicts.reason: Meta had 0 conversions on every day from Oct 18 to Oct 31 on $8,082 of spend, and daily spend rose from $526 to $644. Self-reported Instagram/Facebook also fell to 0% in the last two weeks, so the failure looks real and not just a tracking gap. Paused.

Direct rose from 2.2 to 5.4/day while paid spend moved 1.02x. Self-reported AI answers (AI assistant plus ChatGPT) rose from about 6% to 22%. Credit goes to AI and word of mouth, not to any paid channel. No budget move. Direct has since eased from 45 to 31 conversions/week, so I'm watching it.

flags.message: meta spent $8,082 over 14 days with zero conversions, and spend is still rising.
Direct conversions grew 2.4x (2.2 to 5.4/day) while paid spend moved 1.02x. Self-reported AI answers went from 7% to 22%. Something untracked is driving buyers.

label: synthetic data
